note: The reference plan shipped in the Luna repo (test business, no client data). It shows the shape every generated plan follows.

paragraphs: Test is an early-stage B2B2C professional services firm with strong unit economics, yet critical gaps in digital presence, referral systematization, and marketing consistency are suppressing growth well below its potential. This 180-day plan prioritizes high-ROI foundational investments first: a professional website, a formal referral program, and a consistent email marketing system.

These three activities alone can deliver **50 to 100% revenue growth within six months** without significant budget outlay, by converting existing goodwill from satisfied clients into documented referrals and repeat engagements.

From Day 31 onward, the plan builds an inbound pipeline through consistent LinkedIn thought leadership targeting ambitious Nigerian business owners aged 25 to 44, a downloadable AI Readiness lead magnet gated behind email capture, and tiered service packages that reduce conversion friction. Podcast guest appearances establish regional authority at zero production cost. By Month 4 to 6, the business will have a multi-channel acquisition engine operating within its ₦0 to ₦500K budget and 3 to 5 hour weekly time constraint.

callout.title: HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED
callout.body: Five KPIs, reviewed monthly: referrals received, website consultation bookings, LinkedIn engagement rate, email open rates, and new-client source attribution. Every action is sequenced to build on the prior one rather than compete for limited time and budget.

customerJourney.intro: The strategy maps to three stages: attracting the right prospects, converting them into qualified leads, and turning customers into a repeat, referral-generating base.

columns.heading: Target Market
columns.body: Ambitious Nigerian business owners and executives aged 25 to 44, earning ₦30M to ₦50M annually, based in regional capitals or commercial hubs. Time-poor but resourceful, digitally engaged, making research-driven decisions over 1 to 4 weeks and responding to peer recommendations and ROI.

columns.heading: Core Message
columns.body: Test helps owners achieve measurable profitability improvements and navigate AI adoption through personalized services across the full B2B2C value chain. Unlike generalists, we deliver end-to-end expertise backed by documented case studies and media-verified credibility.

columns.heading: Media Channels
columns.body: LinkedIn for organic thought leadership at near-zero cost. Podcast guest appearances on Nigerian business shows to build regional authority. Referral and event marketing to access the peer-driven trust economy at the lowest acquisition cost.

columns.heading: Lead Capture
columns.body: An "AI Readiness for Nigerian Businesses" self-assessment, gated behind an email form and promoted via LinkedIn and podcasts. A free 30-minute strategy consultation serves as the primary homepage CTA.

columns.heading: Lead Nurture
columns.body: A 5-email automated welcome sequence delivers the resource, a success story, a tip, a case study, and a time-framed offer. A segmented monthly newsletter reinforces three weekly LinkedIn posts for multi-touch visibility.

columns.heading: Sales Conversion
columns.body: A discovery-first framework protects the 25 to 50% close rate: targeted questions, then a tailored proposal within 48 hours. Three packages anchor perception toward the mid-tier, with ROI framing in naira terms.

columns.heading: Deliver Experience
columns.body: A structured onboarding checklist within 24 hours of signing, a 30-60-90 day check-in cadence with a mid-project NPS survey, and a client success dashboard that visually demonstrates value.

columns.heading: Lifetime Value
columns.body: Quarterly strategic reviews surface new needs. 2 to 3 upsell pathways (project to retainer, strategy to AI implementation) introduced at the 60-day check-in. Target: lift repeat business from 25 to 50% toward 60 to 70%.

columns.heading: Referrals
columns.body: A formal program launched within 30 days, with value-based incentives rather than cash, embedded into offboarding to make it automatic. Target: grow referral-sourced revenue from 10 to 25% toward 35 to 50% within 6 months.

strengths: High average customer value of ₦500K to ₦2M means even 3 to 5 new clients per quarter produces significant revenue impact, making relationship-based marketing highly efficient.
A 25 to 50% consultation-to-close rate is well above industry norms, indicating strong consultative selling capability that should be systematized and protected.
The B2B2C model creates multi-directional value that pure B2B or B2C competitors cannot replicate, providing structural differentiation.
Existing media coverage and satisfied-customer proof points are high-credibility assets, currently underutilized and best placed front-and-center.
The agility of a 2 to 5 person team enables faster customization than larger competitors, a genuine selling point for executives who value speed.
opportunities: AI adoption advisory is a largely underserved niche in regional Nigerian professional services, offering first-mover positioning.
A formalized referral program is the single highest-ROI growth activity: ₦0 to ₦25K against ₦500K to ₦2M client values means a 20 to 80x return.
LinkedIn thought leadership is virtually uncontested among regional peers, making consistent posting a low-cost path to visibility.
The absence of a website is both the biggest weakness and the highest-leverage quick win; even a 5-page site unlocks credibility.
Podcast guest appearances offer immediate access to aligned audiences at zero production budget, building authority before competitors.

risks.label: Capacity constraint.
risks.body: Successful marketing could generate more demand than a 2 to 5 person team can service. Build a waitlist process and scalable delivery frameworks proactively.

risks.label: Budget exhaustion.
risks.body: At ₦0 to ₦500K, allocate at least 60% to website and email platform as foundational infrastructure before any paid advertising.

risks.label: AI credibility.
risks.body: Positioning as an AI advisor while internally learning the tools requires transparent "fellow navigator" framing, supported by rapidly-built internal case studies.

risks.label: Client concentration.
risks.body: If any single client exceeds 30% of revenue, its loss threatens continuity, making the new-client acquisition program urgent.

risks.label: Inconsistent execution.
risks.body: With only 3 to 5 hours weekly, focus on exactly two channels (LinkedIn and email) and batch content with scheduling tools.

risksPositioning.positioning: Position the business as the regional **AI-forward professional services partner** for ambitious Nigerian business owners who need both strategic guidance and practical implementation across the full B2B2C value chain, resting on three pillars: specialization in AI adoption and profitability, end-to-end B2B2C expertise, and a track record validated by media coverage and measurable results.

callout.title: COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGE & GROWTH POTENTIAL
callout.body: B2B2C structural expertise, genuine AI advisory capability, and a high-touch model create a moat neither large national firms nor freelancers can replicate. Conservative projection: 50 to 100% revenue growth in the first 6 months; 2 to 3x within 12 to 18 months; 5 to 10x long-term with productized packages and geographic expansion. The primary ceiling is delivery capacity, so document scalable frameworks now.

implementation.intro: Three sequenced phases across 180 days. Each phase establishes infrastructure the next one depends on, so nothing competes for the same limited time and budget.

phases.title: Foundation
steps: Register a domain and build a 5-page mobile-optimized website on Wix or WordPress for ₦50K to ₦150K, with 2 to 3 anonymized case studies, media logos, and a Calendly CTA.
Publish a one-page referral program, then personally contact every current and past client via WhatsApp or phone within two weeks.
Create a Mailchimp or Brevo account, import contacts into three segments, and send a warm reactivation email to past clients.
Optimize the LinkedIn page with AI-forward positioning and publish the first three posts.
Draft the 5-email welcome sequence and install Calendly, testing the booking flow on mobile.
Batch-schedule three LinkedIn posts per week for four weeks in a single 90-minute session using Buffer.

phases.title: Pipeline
steps: Create the AI Readiness assessment in Canva (10 scored questions), gate it behind an email form, and promote it for six weeks.
Pitch 10 to 15 Nigerian business podcasts, targeting one confirmed appearance by Day 60.
Define three tiered packages: Starter (₦300K–₦500K), Growth (₦700K–₦1.2M), Enterprise (custom).
Send the first segmented monthly newsletter with one insight, one win, and one tailored CTA.
Introduce a post-project offboarding checklist with an NPS survey and a written referral ask.
Track five KPIs weekly and develop a 90-minute discovery-call framework with 48-hour proposals.

phases.title: Scale
steps: Publish the first AI advisory case study (600 to 800 words) and repurpose it across channels.
Host an invitation-only roundtable (10 to 15 prospects) with a 48-hour follow-up sequence.
Introduce quarterly strategic reviews as standard, targeting repeat business of 60 to 70%.
Repurpose podcast audio into short LinkedIn clips to extend reach and build social proof.
Evaluate ₦100K to ₦150K of LinkedIn Sponsored Content, measuring cost-per-lead against the organic benchmark.
Document all delivery steps into a shared Drive folder, then run a full 180-day KPI review and reallocate.

resources.intro: The entire plan runs on free and low-cost tooling, with most of the budget reserved as contingency for a paid test once organic data is in.

items.label: Website:
items.body: Wix Business or WordPress + Hostinger (₦50K–₦150K one-time); domain ₦5K–₦15K/year.

items.label: Email platform:
items.body: Mailchimp free tier (up to 500 contacts) or Brevo, ₦0 to start.

items.label: LinkedIn scheduling:
items.body: Buffer free tier, ₦0; upgrade (~₦8K/month) only if volume requires.

items.label: Lead magnet design:
items.body: Canva free tier, sufficient for the PDF assessment, ₦0.

items.label: Scheduling tool:
items.body: Calendly free tier for consultation booking, ₦0.

items.label: Referral program:
items.body: One-page document in Google Docs/Canva, ₦0; incentives are service-based.

items.label: Contingency reserve:
items.body: ₦100K–₦200K held for a Sponsored Content test or speaking opportunity.

callout.title: WEEKLY TIME ALLOCATION
callout.body: 90 minutes of LinkedIn content batching (weekly), 60 minutes of email and newsletter writing (monthly), 30 minutes of referral follow-up calls (weekly), and 60 minutes of proposal and discovery-call preparation.

kpis.intro: Eight metrics, reviewed at Day 60, Day 90, and Day 180, tell you which channels deserve more time and budget and which need rework.

rows.tracked: Google Sheet with source and conversion per referral
Follower count and engagement in LinkedIn Analytics
Website form submissions in list-growth report
Originating channel logged for every signed client

kpis.note: **Trigger:** if the close rate drops below 25% for two consecutive months, review and revise the discovery-call framework and proposal template before scaling spend.

templates.intro: Four assets you can build once and reuse for every prospect, so execution never stalls on a blank page.

cards.title: Referral Program One-Pager
cards.body: Headline: "Refer a Business Leader, Earn Exclusive Access." Three sections — How It Works, What You Receive (first access at a reserved rate, or one complimentary 60-minute review per signed referral), and Submit a Referral. Footer carries a client testimonial. Tone: warm, peer-level, never transactional.

cards.title: 5-Email Welcome Sequence
cards.body: Email 1 (immediate): deliver the assessment + a P.S. inviting their biggest AI question. Email 2 (Day 2): a 150-word client story with a naira outcome. Email 3 (Day 4): a practical tool tip. Email 4 (Day 7): a detailed case study. Email 5 (Day 10): a time-framed, no-obligation consultation offer.

cards.title: Discovery Call Framework
cards.body: Open by confirming the goal is to understand fully before recommending. Five questions: biggest operational challenge; where profitability is most compressed; what they've tried; team familiarity with AI; what solving it in 90 days is worth in naira. Close by summarizing back and confirming the 48-hour proposal.

cards.title: Monthly Newsletter Template
cards.body: Section 1: "This Month in AI" (100 words). Section 2: "Client Win" (80 words, a naira outcome). Section 3: a CTA block switched by segment — prospects get a strategy-call offer, current clients an AI Advisory upsell, past clients a catch-up invitation.

investmentRoi.intro: Where to put the first naira, and what each move is expected to return.

investments.title: Website development
investments.body: The single highest-leverage investment. Without it, every other digital effort is undermined and the credibility gap stays open.

investments.title: Email marketing platform
investments.body: Stand up Mailchimp or Brevo immediately to begin building the segmented list and automated sequence that drive retention.

investments.title: Referral program launch
investments.body: The highest-ROI activity in the plan. A one-page document and personal outreach cost almost nothing against ₦500K–₦2M in referral value.

investments.title: AI Readiness lead magnet
investments.body: A professionally designed assessment that anchors LinkedIn, podcast, and event traffic at the top of the funnel.

investments.title: LinkedIn scheduling tool
investments.body: Buffer or Hootsuite enables the batch creation needed to hold a 3-post-per-week cadence within the time budget.

investments.title: Contingency fund
investments.body: Held for a speaking opportunity or a targeted Sponsored Content test once organic performance data guides the spend.

callout.title: EXPECTED RETURN
callout.body: The referral program alone, converting one additional client, returns ₦500K–₦2M against under ₦25K, a minimum 20x ROI in 90 days. A ₦150K website pays back 3 to 13x on a single warm conversion per quarter. LinkedIn and email, at a 25 to 50% close rate and ₦750K average deal, represent ₦562K–₦1.875M in monthly pipeline.

Prioritize Phase 1 activities and assign clear ownership.
Set up the tracking systems for the recommended KPIs.
Schedule regular review meetings to assess progress.
Consider professional implementation support if capacity becomes the bottleneck.
